content: Which policy has the highest loss ratio, and what is it?

name: query_salesforce

content:
The highest loss ratio belongs to [ANT-HO-204585](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKdxxAAC/view), an active homeowners policy for [Okafor Household](/lightning/r/001aj000040t3cpAAA/view). Its loss ratio is **2,162.9%**: **$48,450** in incurred losses against an annual premium of **$2,240**.

The next two highest:
- [ANT-PA-204857](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKdyDAAS/view) (Personal Auto, [Haddad Household](/lightning/r/001aj000040t3cxAAA/view)): **2,006.9%**, with $58,000 in losses on $2,890 premium
- [ANT-RN-204602](/lightning/r/a00aj00003jKdxyAAC/view) (Renters, [Lindqvist Household](/lightning/r/001aj000040t3cqAAA/view)): **1,600.9%**, with $3,650 in losses on $228 premium
